appearance.title: BM 91711 Arban provenance assessment
appearance.description: Waller assesses the British Museum accessions-register attribution of BM 91711 to Layard's excavation at Arban.

claims.value_text: Arban attribution is plausible but unverified
claims.notes: Waller reports that the museum accessions register attributes the bowl to Layard's excavation at Arban, Syria, but Layard does not record finding a bowl there and his prospectus does not mention an Arban bowl.

claims.value_text: museum accessions-register attribution lacking corroboration in the excavator's published account
claims.notes: This assessment qualifies the evidence basis. It does not delete the British Museum-derived Arban findspot claim or establish a different findspot.
